title: small shaker container
text: small shaker container. I purchased this container to put baking soda in - for cleaning purposes.  I am a bit disappointed because the top doesn't stay on very well.  If you are considering this for airtightness - it obviously is not - it has a shaker top and just a flap for closure.  It's a good size - but as I said, the top just isn't secure enough - it doesn't snap on - it just sort of sits down on the base.  Now, to be fair, it has not come off when I have been shaking it out - but because I know the top doesn't feel secure, I sort of hold it on.  Eh.  The base is a frosty clear plastic and the top is a solid red plastic. It is small - one box of baking soda just fits in it.  I wanted to like this as I like to use baking soda for soft scrubbing - add a little vinegar in the sink for disinfecting property - no scary chemicals.  But I will have to find a better dispenser for the baking soda. I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info should seem useful.  And I hope this info was helpful to you.
